description: This file defines the interface for plugins within the WPEFramework, including plugin lifecycle management, communication, security, and notification mechanisms. It declares the IPlugin interface and related nested interfaces for plugin notifications, web communication, WebSocket, text socket, channel, security, and authentication.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Main plugin interface providing lifecycle methods (Initialize, Deinitialize, Information) and nested notification interfaces.

classes.name: IPlugin::INotification
classes.description: Interface for plugin state change notifications (Activated, Deactivated, Unavailable).

classes.name: IPlugin::ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for plugin lifetime management (Initialize, Deinitialized).

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extended plugin interface supporting communication channel attachment and detachment.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin
classes.description: Interface for composite plugins with registration and notification management.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for plugin activation and deactivation events.

classes.name: IWeb
classes.description: Interface for web request handling and processing.

classes.name: IWebSocket
classes.description: Interface for WebSocket communication, handling inbound messages.

classes.name: ITextSocket
classes.description: Interface for text socket communication, handling inbound messages.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data channel communication, inbound and outbound data.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security checks on WebSocket upgrades, requests, and JSONRPC messages, and token retrieval.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for token creation and security officer retrieval based on tokens.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell, returning an error string if initialization fails.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin as a JSON string.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a communication channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a communication channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification handler for plugin events.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests or WebSocket messages.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a web request and returns a response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound WebSocket messages, deserializing JSON objects.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound raw data on a communication channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Sends raw data over a communication channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket upgrade or request is allowed.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a security token from a buffer.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Retrieves the security officer interface for a given token.
